native_map_only_implementation.scope: supervised initial_scene_only InitDiffusion; finetune=true; sep_map=false; learn_init=true; no GAIL
native_map_only_implementation.loading: Only encoder.map_encoder.*; exact keys, shape, dtype and finite values validated before any copy; strict=True map state load.
native_map_only_implementation.freezing: All shared-map parameters require_grad=false; SMART.train() keeps the loaded map and its children in eval mode; optimizer contains only G1.
native_map_only_implementation.startup: action=fit; ckpt_path=null. Map-only initializer does not load source optimizer, loops, scheduler, G1 or EMA.

native_loading_risks: action=fit with this source ckpt_path invokes Lightning whole-training resume, including old step/optimizer state; use null for a fresh G1 fit.

Existing action=finetune loads the entire state_dict with strict=False. This source has no G1 keys, but this path is broader than the requested map-only scope and can silently import G1 from a different source. The new initial_map_checkpoint avoids that.

Changing decoder.hidden_dim, num_freq_bands, num_heads/head_dim or num_map_layers can make the loaded map structurally incompatible; strict checking rejects key/shape/dtype failures. Nonparameter graph radii, neighbors and crop remain deliberate condition changes and must be recorded.
Parent train() resets child train/eval state; the new explicit map-only mode fixes this so a frozen dropout map cannot become stochastic.

InitDiffusion._make_args currently defaults its G1 to hidden_dim=256, num_denoiser_layers=3, dropout=0, sampling_steps=20. Shared decoder architecture settings are not equivalent denoiser hyperparameters. Expose/record any genuinely tuned denoiser setting instead of assuming these knobs propagate.
sep_map=true would encode the initialization with init_map_encoder, not the loaded shared map. The new option explicitly rejects it so fixed-map semantics cannot silently change.
quick_sweep_fairness_requirements: Every fresh arm must have the same byte-identical pretrained map hash, all map gradients absent, and post-fit map hash equal to pre-fit map hash; no map EMA is needed.

Reset the same training seed before model initialization; within an unchanged architecture, identical fresh G1 and fresh EMA hashes are required. Different architecture arms cannot claim identical G1 hashes; record parameter-layout changes and use multiple independent training seeds for confirmation.
Use one seeded full TRAIN manifest, same order and sample exposures across arms. Count final partial batches and compare both optimizer-step budgets and data exposures when batch size changes.
Continuation must preserve optimizer, epoch scheduler, EMA and RNG and avoid replaying consumed data. Do not reset Adam/EMA at a milestone and call it uninterrupted from-scratch training.

Use TRAIN-only explicit normalizer statistics. Reuse the existing 7D normalizer only for the same scalar-speed and linear-size representation. Log shape, vector velocity or type-feature changes require representation-consistent TRAIN calibration.

Use matched GT for each generated cohort, actual num_samples equals requested cohort, full unpartitioned reference lanes, generated type filtering, identical ego fixation and map crop within a comparable group.

The seven native metrics have different scale conventions: near/lat are raw JSD times10, angle/length/width/speed times100; collision is percent. Keep native scales when using the existing auxiliary S formula.

All prior search and heldout cohorts have been inspected for selection. Treat them as validation; use a newly held-out manifest for independent confirmation if search decisions use the previous 4096, and do not call reused 50k data an untouched test set.

Freeze the score, coverage/count guards, primary EMA/online mode, training budget and seeds before final confirmation. Disclose per-metric tradeoffs instead of claiming seven-metric improvement from S alone.
Short-run forecasts cannot establish a final128-epoch optimum. Compare late curves and at least two training budgets because the prior search showed the old loss catching up.
